st: God Help Ye Merry Bundy Men
d: As Al and Griff lose their jobs on Christmas Eve, Marcy and Jefferson's entry in a neighborhood contest is sabotaged by Kelly and Bud.

t: Vore værste år: You Better Watch Out
d: When Santa Claus crash-lands in the Bundy's backyard, Al pinch-hits for old Saint Nick.

t: Vore værste år: It's A Bundyful Life (Part I)
d: On Christmas the Bundy family is destined to go presentless, again, unless Al can find a way to make some quick cash.

t: Vore værste år: It's A Bundyful Life (Part II)
d: Al blows his only chance to give the family a Merry Christmas and is visited by a not-so-angelic angel.

d: Al does his yearly pre-Christmas inspection of the family and can find they've done nothing wrong, which means he has to buy them presents, but he has to take a job as a Department Store Santa to pay for the gifts.

d: Al misses the D'Arcy's annual Christmas party, unaware that he wasn't invited.
